verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI evidenced is Chloe, an AI sales agent that calls leads, qualifies prospects, books meetings and updates the CRM. That is agentic action, not AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced from the user's data. The MCP server gives external tools like Claude access to Close data, which happens outside the product. Smart fields are plain calculated fields, not AI. These are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
